It is submitted by the learned AGP for the State that, the rate determined by the Special Land Acquisition Officer (SLAO) for the acquired lands was ranging between Rs. 88,000/- to Rs.
1,04,000/- per hectare and the learned Reference Court has enhanced the same to Rs. 1,81,500/-
per hectare.
She submits that, the rate of enhancement by the learned Reference Court is within four (4) times.

She fairly submits that, the Government has taken a policy decision by issuing Government Resolution (G.R.) dated 03/11/2016, not to challenge the award passed by the learned Reference Court, wherein the enhancement is within four times.
She further submits that, an appropriate order be passed.

3. None for the Respondents.

sentences.text:
The papers on record shows that, the Respondents' land situated at village Gondpimpari, Tq.
Kuhi, District Nagpur, out of various survey numbers came to be acquired for the Gosikhurd Rehabilitation Project.
The SLAO determined the compensation for the different survey number within the range between Rs. 88,000/- to Rs. 1,11,746/- per hectare.
Being not satisfied with the compensation determined by the SLAO, the 4 18) FA 553-2015-J.odt Respondents preferred the Reference Application/LAC No. 131/2008 for enhancement in the compensation.

The learned Reference Court by impugned judgment and award enhanced the compensation to Rs. 1,81,500/-
per hectare.
Against the said enhancement, this Appeal is filed.

5. Undisputedly, the State Government by issuing the G.R. dated 03/11/2016 and Corrigendum dated 23/02/2017 has taken a policy decision not to challenge the award under the Land Acquisition Act, wherein the enhancement is within four (4) times.
Considering the above rate determined by the SLAO and enhanced by the learned Reference Court, it is clear that, the enhancement is within four (4) times.
The Appeal, is therefore, covered by the said G.R.
Hence, the following order:-
ORDER i) The Appeal stands dismissed in view of the aforesaid the G.R. dated 03/11/2016 and Corrigendum dated 23/02/2017.
No order order as to costs.
ii) R & P be sent back to the learned Reference Court.
